name: WhatsApp enquiry follow-up
summary: A pipeline for a small business whose customers write on WhatsApp: record the enquiry, reply fast, send a quote, follow up in days, confirm the order and remember the repeat purchase.
description: Turn WhatsApp chats into worked enquiries: every chat becomes an enquiry with what the customer wants, the quote and how long it is valid, a dated next step, a payment stage and a date to come back when the answer was later. Each contact records whether they agreed to be messaged and when a reorder is due. Replies are written one by one and reviewed. It does not send broadcasts, campaigns or chatbot menus, and it does not use the official WhatsApp Business Platform. WhatsApp may restrict an account used in a way its policy forbids.

prompt.intro: Set up WhatsApp enquiry follow-up in my Customermates workspace: an enquiry for every chat with a quote and its validity, a dated next step, a payment stage, a come-back date and a reorder date per contact, plus the contact's WhatsApp permission. Write replies one by one for my review and send nothing in bulk.
questions: What do customers ask you about on WhatsApp, and how do you quote?
How fast do you want to answer a new chat?
How many days do you wait after a quote before you follow up, and when do you stop?
Do customers reorder, and after how long?
